name: Vin
self_text: Hi! I'm Vin, a German guy in my mid 20s. In my free time, I love sketching buildings. I mainly play Skyforge Arena on a handheld, usually queuing for casual matches. I communicate over text chat while playing. I'm looking for someone to coach me. I am free Saturday morning or Saturday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available either Saturday morning or Saturday afternoon, and it's a deal-breaker unless we overlap on text chat. It would be nice if you are the one who coaches me, and it's a small bonus if you are into casual matches.
